Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux, Falcon Container
This event is generated when the sensor generates an indicator. An indicator is like a detection event (AssociateTreeIdWithRoot) except that it is not
necessarily malicious, either because it is just an indicator (e.g. when a process opens the Recycle Bin) or because CrowdStrike is not yet confident enough in
the indicator to trigger it as a detection. Note that a detection, unlike an indicator, establishes a detection tree (AssociateTreeIdWithRoot) which causes the
sensor to send additional information for that process tree for analysis/hunting purposes. An indicator is just a single event that has no other sensor impact.
